summary: Klickitat County, WA lookout: L-4 cab on a tower built 1930 on Monte Cristo; no longer standing per the Register; Forest Service says evidence remains along Trail 53.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a tower, built 1930
facts.status_note: Register says the lookout is no longer standing; firelookout.com marks it abandoned and gone; the Forest Service says evidence of an old fire lookout can still be found on Trail 53

access.note: Trail 53 is open to hikers, bikers and horse riders per the Forest Service; no closure described in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Forest Service Trail 53 is 4.1 miles from the upper trailhead on Forest Road 8600-080. Willhite's North Trail has a hiking distance of 2 miles and its access leaves Highway 141 west of Trout Lake; the last mile is rough, rocky road and there is no parking where the trail leaves the road.

events.note: L-4 cab on a tower constructed on the site
USGS survey referred to a monument 44 feet east of the lookout house's center; the source does not say whether the lookout was in use
Registered April 15, 2020, nominated by Tammy McLeod

notes_for_editor: Removal date is unknown. A search snippet for a wildflower hiking guide (science.halleyhosting.com) says the lookout was removed in the 1950s; it was not fetched and is not used. Willhite photo captions (Eyebolt, Flagpole, Glass, Summit Benchmark, 2019 views) are not described in text, so they were left out. Firetower photos (1934 panoramics, National Archives Pacific Northwest Region) have no image URLs in the cache; none added. The brief's record (1930 build, 2020 registration, gone) matches the sources; no correction needed.
